title: Principal-and-Interest Share of a Rural Home Loans Replacement Remittance
content:
On Rural Home Loans, the principal-and-interest share that a replacement remittance carries depends on the reopened monthly bill and the note rate on record.

## Rule

The principal-and-interest share the replacement carries is chosen as follows: when the reopened monthly bill is not the final scheduled payment and the note rate on the loan record differs from the rate that bill was billed at, because a rate change took effect after it, the share is the principal and interest that the most recent returned remittance reversed; when the reopened bill is the final scheduled payment, the share is the interest billed on it plus the whole principal balance; otherwise the share is the monthly principal-and-interest payment on the loan record.

## Terms

- **The reopened monthly bill:** the monthly interest bill whose payment the most recent returned remittance reversed, identified by the due date on that remittance's return entries.
- **The rate that bill was billed at:** the note rate shown on that monthly interest bill.
- **Final scheduled payment:** a reopened bill whose due date is the maturity date on the loan record.
- **Principal and interest the most recent return reversed:** the amounts on its interest payment return and principal payment return added together, rounded to the cent.

## Decision table

| Reopened bill is the final scheduled payment | Note rate on record differs from the bill's rate | Principal-and-interest share |
|---|---|---|
| no | yes | interest plus principal reversed by the most recent return |
| yes | either | interest billed on that bill plus the whole principal balance |
| no | no | the monthly principal-and-interest payment on the loan record |

## Worked cases (hypothetical records)

- An adjustable loan billed a month at 5.75 percent, then changed rate to 6.5 percent; that month's remittance, which paid interest 812.40 and principal 340.10, comes back. The note rate on record now differs from the bill's rate, so the share is 1152.50.
- A reopened bill due on the maturity date, with interest of 9.85 billed on it and a principal balance of 1965.00: the share is 1974.85.
